status: The owner clarified on 2026-10-08 that version one is complete and its release application is in progress, but player testing has not started and there are no players. This supersedes earlier wording that testing was live. Repository/mobile upload baseline remains 0.1.1 (5); last retained Console evidence is Alpha Changes in review. Console was not rechecked; approval, production access and testing start dates are not asserted. A fresh SQLite-only design for runtime content, saves, statistics and preferences is confirmed but not implemented; existing package declarations still describe the submitted build.
distribution: All countries and regions available in Google Play Console
track: Alpha closed testing; production release after this app completes testing and receives required access. No separate open testing / Early Access planned.
accessInstructions: All game functionality is available without sign-in. Mainline puzzles unlock in sequence; completed puzzles can be replayed. Bonus puzzles appear after each group of twenty mainline puzzles. No access credentials, memberships or regional authentication are needed.
audienceIntent: Owner confirmed ages 6 and above, including children and adults; do not select age 5 and under.

dataSafety.localData: Progress, undo history, earned hint credits and game preferences remain in private device storage. Android backup is disabled in the public build.
dataSafety.sensitivePermissions: No advertising ID, microphone, camera, location, contacts or shared-storage access. Public Android build has no INTERNET permission.
dataSafety.deletion: Clear app storage in Android settings or uninstall. Support emails are separate, optional correspondence and can be deleted on request.

contentRatingEvidence.notes: Answer IARC questions from actual final content. Do not preassign an official rating. Colourful liquid is water, with no alcohol consumption. Cosmetic style labels currently include Champagne Flute and Faceted Martini; disclose this terminology if the questionnaire asks about references, rather than assume every rating answer is No.

controlledSubstance.source: Champagne Flute and Faceted Martini cosmetic style labels

futureFeatures: Referral settlement and Premium are planned but not implemented in the current test build. Reassess app access, in-app purchases, networking, privacy and data safety before any build includes those features.
